description: Room-level data of Simulated Energy consumption and Ventilation dynamics (RSimEV) is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Naimeh Sadeghi. This dataset offers simulated data that includes various parameters impacting energy consumption and ventilation across diverse building scenarios. The simulations encompass various room types within buildings of varying shapes and sizes. Comprising a total of 312 CSV files, each file corresponds to simulations conducted in different rooms within buildings with random parameters. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
